feat(boogie): unify admin flows for source template and server

Summary:
- migrate boogie source and server pages to a shared list-and-editor
  layout instead of modal-only CRUD
- move boogie template management to the same admin interaction while
  keeping source binding and element editing available
- keep existing boogie routes and request integration intact and align
  the source page API typing with its query shape

Rationale:
- make the three boogie menu pages match the new admin's list/edit
  interaction expectations without changing menu or backend contracts
- preserve module scope by only touching boogie pages and their local
  request typing

Tests:
- npx -y yarn@1.22.22 build:dev
- npx -y yarn@1.22.22 typecheck (fails on pre-existing repo-wide TS
  issues; filtered output shows no remaining errors in boogie files)
